prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select a ready-to-adopt desktop pet or create a custom one.", "Instant Starter Pets"]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Click to pet, right-click for settings, or drag to reposition on your desktop screen.", "Right-click pet to access settings & sleep mode", "Got It!"]
3: ["Practice Desktop Commands", "Try moving your pet helper around while your pet gets ready.", "Drag me to your favorite screen corner!"]
4: ["Did you know? You can drag your pet anywhere on your taskbar."]
5: ["Sign in with the same email to keep your saved pets across desktop sessions."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Claim your free desktop companion starter toy kit.", "Free Starter Toy Included"]
7: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to join you."]
8: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Pick a fast setup or create a custom pet from your own photos."]
9: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look at the bottom corner of your screen. If hidden, click the system tray icon to reveal your pet.", "Double-click taskbar icon anytime to bring pet to top."]
